title: Unscripted: Domain-Driven Design vs. Spec-Driven Development, are they melting into the same coin in the age of AI?
abstract: The question on the table: with AI in the mix, are domain-driven design and spec-driven development still two different things? This is our unscripted stage. No slides, no script, and no idea where it ends up.

speakers.name: Xin Yao
speakers.role_company: Bringing sociotechnical thinking into software architecture
